dedupe_keys.name: program package for emission reduction strategies in energy use and supply perseus

description: Program Package for Emission Reduction Strategies in Energy Use and Supply (PERSEUS) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Institute for Industrial Production (IIP); Chair of Energy Economics; Karlsruhe Insitute of Technology. PERSEUS has been used previously to analyse the benefits of international mechanisms to investigate the future electricity mix and effects of the emissions trading scheme on the European electricity sector. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: national states, regions. Software: GAMS. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
